summary: Releases up to three sub-objects stored in the three consecutive dword slots starting at this+7 (byte offset this+0x1C). For each non-null slot, dispatches vtable slot 0 (Release) with the final flag argument 1, then nulls the slot. Returns the result of the last Release dispatch. Called from ObjectVTableSwitchDestructor (0x004C9360) as part of object teardown.

operations.description: Iterate three consecutive dword slots starting at this+7 (this+0x1C), one slot per sub-object.
Skip a slot when its sub-object pointer is null; only non-null sub-objects are released.
Dispatch the sub-object's vtable slot 0 (Release) via __thiscall with the final flag argument 1.
Null the released slot so the same sub-object is not released twice.
Advance the slot pointer by one dword and decrement the three-iteration counter.
Return the result of the last Release dispatch.

unresolved: Identity of the sub-object class and meaning of the Release argument (1) is unknown; callers own the vtable layout.
result is uninitialized when every slot is null (it is read only after a successful dispatch).
